You have launched the experimental beta branch of the game Norland. We're striving to make it stable, but anything can happen! Also, saves made in the experimental branch may be temporarily incompatible with the regular branch of the game (if you decide to switch back). That’s why we've created a backup of all your saves in a separate folder: %localappdata%/Strategy/saves/backup/. To access it in Windows, press WIN+R, type %localappdata%/Strategy/, and press Enter. If you want to return to these saves, just move them to the saves/ folder. Your feedback on the changes we’re making is very important to us, so we look forward to hearing from you on the Steam forum or in our Discord. Thank you!
